countries.f.flags: Image importer that generates the 5 `.tga` flags in `gfx/flags/`: `TAG`, `TAG_monarchy`, `TAG_republic`, `TAG_communist` and `TAG_fascist`.
countries.f.history_fields: Primary and accepted cultures, religion, government type, capital, unlocked technologies and reforms.
countries.f.parties: `common/countries/[Name].txt` with a visual party editor: ideology, economic, religious and military policies, and activation dates.
countries.f.tag: Unique 3-letter code (e.g. `XYZ`) checked against the existing ones.
countries.intro: A wizard that automates everything involved in creating a country in Victoria II: TAG, flags, parties, units and history, generating every file in its place.
encoding.utf8_bom: UTF-8 with BOM — the game expects Windows-1252
events.f.conditions: Year or date, technologies and country or province variables through drop-down menus and search boxes.
events.f.header: Unique ID, title and description linked to localisation.
events.f.localisation: Title, description and option keys register themselves in the localisation module to be translated into Spanish and English.
events.f.mtth_mods: Dynamic modifiers by era or by conditions.
events.f.options: Several decision buttons with effects on the country, provinces and POPs.
events.f.vanilla: Load and edit base game events without losing their formatting.
events.intro: A visual builder to create events from scratch or to load, view and edit the base game ones (`events/*.txt`) without typing a single brace by hand.
file_error.not_file: it is a folder, not a file
file_error.not_found: the file does not exist (was it moved or deleted?)
file_error.permission: you do not have permission to read it
header.language_tooltip: Switch the interface language instantly, no restart needed
image.actual_tooltip: Show the image at actual size (one image pixel per screen pixel)
image.failed_dds:
Pillow cannot decode this DDS file: it may use a compression this version does not support, or be damaged. The game will still read it; only the preview is unavailable.

Details: {error}
image.failed_text:
Pillow cannot open this image (unsupported format or damaged file).

Details: {error}
image.fit_tooltip: Fit the image to the panel (small images are enlarged without smoothing, with crisp pixels)
loc.col.extras_tooltip: Fields after the “x” marker: the game ignores them, but they are kept on save
loc.col.key_tooltip: CSV column {column} (counting from 0): the key used by scripts (if repeated, the game uses the first one)
loc.col.lang_tooltip_hidden: CSV column {column} ({name}): the vanilla game does not display this language
loc.col.lang_tooltip_shown: CSV column {column} ({name}): a language the game displays
loc.col.marker_tooltip: CSV column {column}: the “x” end marker used by the vanilla files
loc.diagnostics_tooltip: Double-click or press Enter to select the row in the table
loc.read_only: Read-only in this iteration: editing arrives in iteration 2
loc.read_only_tooltip: You can browse, search and validate the CSV; it cannot be modified or saved from here yet
loc.show_all_columns_tooltip: Also shows the 9 languages the game does not use, the “x” marker and the extra fields
loc.show_comments_tooltip: Also shows lines starting with “#” and blank lines
localisation.close_tooltip: Close the open CSV and return to the file list
localisation.empty_text: Open a file from `localisation/` to browse it as a spreadsheet, with one column per language, and review its lint.
localisation.format: Paradox format: `KEY;English;French;German;;Spanish;;;;;;;;;x` — strict semicolons and closing `x`.
localisation.loading: Reading the CSV in the background…
localisation.mod_files_hint: Double-click or press Enter to open a file.
localisation.mod_files_menu_tooltip: Open another file from the mod's localisation/ folder
localisation.mod_files_no_mod: Set the mod folder in “Project & Files” to list its CSV files.
localisation.mod_files_none: The mod has no files in localisation/.
localisation.search_tooltip: Filters rows by key or by the text in any language (available with an open CSV)
map.f.canvas: Fast reading of `provinces.bmp` pixels and of the colours in `definition.csv`.
map.f.economy: Starting economy and factories, order of battle (`oob`) and history.
map.f.live: Changes show up instantly in the active mode.
map.f.modes: Real-time modes: Political, Resources (RGO), Infrastructure, Life Rating and Terrain.
map.f.politics: Ruling party, upper house (`upper_house`), prestige and plurality.
map.f.pops: POP editor: culture, religion, POP type and size.
map.f.storage: Every change is written to `history/provinces/` inside the mod, in Windows-1252.
map.f.tech: Starting technology tree and political and social reforms.
map.f.vanilla: Base game files are read as a reference and never modified.
map.intro: A smoothly zoomable and pannable canvas that simulates the in-game map from `map/provinces.bmp`, `map/definition.csv` and `map/default.map`, with direct editing of every province.
page.countries.subtitle: Step-by-step wizard to create a country from scratch
page.events.subtitle: Visual creation and editing of country_event and province_event
page.localisation.subtitle: Spreadsheet editor for Paradox localisation CSV files (semicolon-separated)
page.map.subtitle: Interactive province map with map modes and click-to-edit
page.project.subtitle: Base game and mod paths, file explorer and preview
planned.arrives: This module arrives in iteration {n} of the roadmap. The architecture already reserves its page, keyboard shortcut and texts.
project.explorer.empty_game: Set the base game folder to browse its files.
project.explorer.empty_mod: Set the mod folder to see its files here.
project.explorer.filter_tooltip: Separate several patterns with ; or , (spaces are part of the name); wildcards * and ? are supported
project.explorer.title: Explorer
project.paths.browse_game_tooltip: Choose the base game install folder
project.paths.edit_tooltip: Type or paste a path and press Enter to validate it
project.paths.title: Paths
project.preview.empty_text: Select a file in the explorer to see its details.
project.preview.note: Clausewitz scripts and images open in their own viewer, and the CSV files in localisation/ in the “Localisation (CSV)” module.
project.preview.open_csv_tooltip: Open this CSV in the “Localisation (CSV)” table (also with a click, double-click or Enter in the explorer)
project.preview.title: Preview
project.tab.files_tooltip: Folder tree of the mod or the base game

validation.filter_text_tooltip: Only shows diagnostics whose file or message contains this text
validation.hint: Double-click or press Enter on a row to open the file at that line.
